The plate holds about 7 yellow rectangular pieces. They look like pineapple chunks, though they could also be cheese or omelet strips. The pale yellow color and slightly translucent look suggest pineapple.

Each piece is roughly 2.5 cm × 1.2 cm × 1 cm, about 3–4 g. Across 7 pieces that comes to about 25 g.

Pineapple has about 50 kcal per 100 g, so 25 g is about 13 kcal.
